dct_creator_sm: Smith, Erika (Mount Royal University, University of Calgary). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6649-9620
dct_description_sm: This dataset is from a survey conducted in 2019 on social media and digital literacies in undergraduate learning. Data was collected using Survey Monkey and primary analysis was conducted using SPSS. The dataset accompanies our article published in the International Journal of Educational Technology in Higher Education in May 2023, available at https://doi.org/10.1186/s41239-023-00398-2.
dct_title_s: Undergraduate Digital Literacies and Social Media Survey
